In short: Arista has no ads, no analytics and no trackers, and never asks for your name, email or password. Your photos, pages, collections and palettes stay on your iPhone. A picture leaves your phone only when you make a page in an AI style or add motion with AI, and only after you have allowed it: it goes to Arista's server and on to the AI service that does the work (OpenAI or fal.ai), and Arista keeps it at most two days. To count credits, Arista gives your phone an anonymous account, which you can delete in the app under Profile → Delete account.

1. Who is responsible

Arista (on the App Store as Arista Studio) is made by Ioniclabs, the developer named on its App Store page, which is responsible for the data described here. Privacy contact: ioniclabs.support@gmail.com.

This policy covers the Arista iPhone app and this website.

2. What stays on your phone

Photos you take or import, the pages you color, your artworks, collections, palettes, scenes, focus settings and your profile (the name and color you choose) are stored in the app on your iPhone. They are included in your iCloud or computer backup if you use one, and are deleted when you delete the app. Pages in the Original style are traced entirely on your iPhone; nothing is sent for them.

3. Your anonymous account

The first time you open Arista, it creates an anonymous account on its server so that credits and purchases can be counted. You never sign in. The account's key is kept in your iPhone's keychain, so the account survives deleting and reinstalling the app on the same phone.

Data on Arista's serverWhyHow long
A random account IDTo know whose credits are whoseUntil you delete the account
Your credit balance and a ledger of each grant and spend: which AI page or clip used credits, its style or motion, and whenTo give you the right credits, refund failed ones and handle disputesUntil you delete the account
The App Store transactions of your subscription (Apple's signed transaction: product, dates, transaction IDs, a renewal status; never your payment details or Apple Account)To give your plan's credits once, renew them, and take them back if Apple refunds a purchaseKept for accounting and to prevent abuse; on account deletion they are kept without your account ID
An identifier of your App Store account for this app (Apple's appTransactionId)So the 30 free credits are given once per App Store account, not once per installKept without your account ID after deletion, for the same reason
The AI's short written description of a picture you animate (what it shows and the motion it suggests; not the picture)To make the clip and keep a daily limit on picture readsUntil you delete the account

4. AI pages and scenes

AI features run only after you allow them on the permission screen; you can withdraw that at any time in Profile → Use photos with AI, and Original pages and basic motion keep working without it.

  • AI page: the photo, resized to at most 1536 pixels, is sent over an encrypted connection to Arista's server, which asks OpenAI to draw the coloring page.
  • AI scene and its landscape version: the framed picture is sent the same way to fal.ai, which runs the video and image models that make the clip or widen the picture (Kling, Wan, FLUX and Google's image model). OpenAI reads the picture to describe it and write the motion.
  • Kept at most two days. Arista's server keeps the photo, the finished page, the framed picture and the clip in private storage so that a page or clip you paid for is never lost if the connection drops, and deletes them as soon as the app has them, or after two days at the latest.
  • The AI services process pictures under their API terms. OpenAI does not use API data to train its models and may keep it for up to 30 days to detect abuse. fal.ai does not use it to train its models; some of the models it runs are provided by their makers (such as Kuaishou for Kling, or Google), who receive the picture to make the clip under their own API terms. Arista never uses your pictures to train AI.
  • Pictures may be checked by the services' safety filters; a picture they refuse is not charged.

6. Purchases

Subscriptions are sold only through Apple's In-App Purchase. Apple takes the payment; Arista never receives your payment details or your Apple Account. The app sends Arista's server the signed transaction Apple gives it, and Apple notifies the server of renewals and refunds, so your credits stay right. Manage or cancel subscriptions in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions; refunds are Apple's to give, at reportaproblem.apple.com.

7. Who processes data, and where

We never sell personal data and share it only with the services Arista needs to run:

  • Supabase (database, storage and server functions), in Singapore;
  • OpenAI, USA: drawing AI pages and reading pictures;
  • fal.ai, USA: running the video and image models for AI scenes, some of them through their makers (Kuaishou for Kling, Google);
  • Apple: the App Store, purchases and their notifications;
  • GitHub (GitHub Pages, USA) hosts this website.

Data may therefore be processed outside your country, including in Singapore and the USA. We rely on these providers' contractual safeguards for such transfers, and follow the procedures that apply to an organisation of our size, including under Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Law (No. 91/2025/QH15).

8. Your rights and deleting your data

  • In the app: Profile → Delete account deletes your account on Arista's server: your credits and ledger, any stored pictures, pages and clips, and the AI's descriptions. App Store transaction records are kept without your account ID, for accounting and to prevent abuse. A subscription is billed by Apple and keeps renewing until you cancel it; the app reminds you and opens Manage subscription.
  • On your phone: delete artworks and collections in the app, or delete the app to remove everything stored in it.
  • Anything else: you may ask to access, correct or delete your data, withdraw consent, or object to processing, under the GDPR, the UK GDPR, the CCPA, Vietnam's PDPL or other laws that apply to you. Write to ioniclabs.support@gmail.com with your account ID (shown in Profile); we reply within 15 days. You may also complain to your data protection authority.

9. Security

Everything between the app and the server travels over encrypted connections. Each account can only reach its own data; pictures are kept in private storage reached only through short-lived links. Purchases are accepted only with Apple's signature, checked on the server. Only the developer can reach the server's data.

10. This website

The site sets no cookies and runs no analytics. It loads two typefaces from Google Fonts, so your browser fetches them from Google. Our host, GitHub, may keep technical logs such as IP addresses to run and secure the service, under its own policy.

11. Children

Arista is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. It has no chat, no social features and no content visible to other people. Purchases need the permission of the Apple Account holder, and Apple's Ask to Buy works as usual.

12. Changes

We publish new versions here with a new effective date, and in the app. If we want to use data for a new purpose, we will ask for your consent first.
